criteria.text: The process produces an inspection-based source map spanning company profiles, PayPal releases and filings, standardized PayPal statements, peer statements, historical materials, and files found irrelevant after opening.
criteria.evidence_hint: Inspect recursive inventory steps, file-opening records, and a source map that classifies documents by issuer, document type, covered period, accounting basis, and likely use.

criteria.text: The process applies an explicit 2026-06-30 information cutoff and marks temporally ineligible material rather than silently incorporating it.
criteria.evidence_hint: Inspect chronology or eligibility notes for document release and filing dates, including explicit exclusion or quarantine of post-cutoff information.

criteria.text: The process converts material propositions into falsifiable questions with predefined confirming and disconfirming observations.
criteria.evidence_hint: Inspect a claim-to-evidence matrix, question plan, or equivalent artifact linking each proposition to management framing, test metrics, time horizon, and possible falsifiers.

criteria.text: The process maintains explicit definitional separation among transaction-margin dollars, transaction-margin rate, GAAP and non-GAAP operating margins, engagement measures, and branded versus consolidated performance.
criteria.evidence_hint: Inspect metric dictionaries, planning notes, table headers, or caveat fields showing that similarly named measures are not treated as interchangeable.

criteria.text: The process establishes the period, definition, unit, and management qualification of a source passage before using it in an interpretation.
criteria.evidence_hint: Inspect source-reading steps around search hits and extraction notes; usable facts should follow contextual reads rather than isolated keyword snippets.

criteria.text: The process maintains a structured fact ledger that distinguishes reported observations from later analyst-derived quantities.
criteria.evidence_hint: Inspect extraction tables or notes for document identity, section or table, period, unit, accounting basis, metric definition, and reported-versus-derived status.

criteria.text: The process stress-tests each provisional interpretation against the strongest available adverse evidence and records whether the interpretation survives, changes, or is rejected.
criteria.evidence_hint: Inspect two-sided evidence tables, explicit alternative explanations, contradiction checks, and revision notes following comparison of favorable and unfavorable observations.

criteria.text: The process explicitly marks unresolved causal or measurement ambiguity instead of filling disclosure gaps with unsupported inference.
criteria.evidence_hint: Inspect uncertainty logs and synthesis caveats for limits such as inability to isolate branded-checkout economics, distinguish volume drivers, or treat pending allegations as established operating facts.

criteria.text: The process provides an auditable calculation trail for every derived quantitative comparison.
criteria.evidence_hint: Inspect calculation work for visible formulas, inputs, periods, units, denominator choices, basis-point conversions, rounding conventions, and investigation of mismatches with disclosed figures.

criteria.text: The process aligns equivalent calendar periods and accounting line items before comparing PayPal operating margins with peer margins.
criteria.evidence_hint: Inspect peer-comparison work for explicit period-end mapping and separately identified revenue and operating-income inputs rather than reliance on fiscal-quarter labels alone.

criteria.text: The process builds a causal synthesis connecting engagement evidence, unbranded-volume choices, transaction expense, transaction count, transaction margin, and consolidated operating margin.
criteria.evidence_hint: Inspect the final reasoning sequence for an integrated mechanism that reconciles the workstreams rather than presenting disconnected metric summaries.

criteria.text: The process resolves the competing interpretations into one explicit position and identifies the primary mechanism supporting that position.
criteria.evidence_hint: Inspect the concluding thesis and preceding adjudication for a clear choice between competing explanations, with residual uncertainty stated without retreating to a merely balanced summary.
